title: MD5 use via Digest.string (ocaml) — review required
description: The ocaml call Digest.string computes MD5, broken for security uses. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms a checksum use or switches to a SHA-2 binding.
remediation: Use a SHA-2 binding for security purposes.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any Digest.string call.
